description: This file contains the documentation and source code for the 'Config' class within the 'Opencart\System\Engine' namespace. The class manages configuration paths and settings, providing methods to add paths, retrieve, set, check, and load configuration data.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: A class that manages configuration paths and data within the OpenCart system engine.

methods.name: addPath
methods.description: Adds a new namespace path to the configuration search paths.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration value by its key.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a configuration key to a specified value.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a configuration key exists.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads configuration data from a specified file.
